    R.push(full(txt(`**${d.heading}**`, W, { size: 11.5, align: 'center' }), { fill: C.peach, solid: true }));
    let x = 0;
    const meta = [['Number of Learners in Class', d.learners], ['Week', d.week], ['Duration', d.duration], ['Form', d.form]];
    const mc = [];
    meta.forEach(([lab, val], i) => {
      const lw = W * META[2 * i], vw = W * META[2 * i + 1];
      mc.push(cell(x, lw, txt(`**${lab}**`, lw, { size: 9.6 }), { fill: lab === 'Duration' ? C.deep : C.pink })); x += lw;
      mc.push(cell(x, vw, txt(val, vw, { size: 9.6 }))); x += vw;
    });
    R.push({ cells: mc, minH: 22, solid: true });
    const lr = (label, blocks, deep) => {
      const lw = W * LAB;
      R.push({ cells: [cell(0, lw, txt(`**${label}**`, lw, { size: 10 }), { fill: deep ? C.deep : C.pink }), cell(lw, W - lw, layoutBlocks(blocks, W - lw - 10, { size: 10 }))], minH: 18 });
    };
    lr('Strand', d.strand); lr('Sub-Strand', d.substrand); lr('Content Standard', d.standard); lr('Learning Outcome(s)', d.outcome);
    lr('Learning Indicator(s)', d.indicators); lr('Essential Question(s)', d.eqs, true); lr('Pedagogical Strategies', d.strategies); lr('Teaching & Learning Resources', d.resources);
    R.push(full([...txt('**Key Notes on Differentiation**', W, { size: 10.2 }), ...txt('Identify the different learner needs in your class and make notes on how to cater for them during the lesson', W, { size: 8.8, i: true, color: C.sub })], { fill: C.pink, keepNext: true, solid: true }));
    R.push(full(layoutBlocks(d.diff, W - 10, { size: 10 })));
    d.lessons.forEach(l => {
      const c = l.title.indexOf(':');
      R.push(full(txt(`**${l.title.slice(0, c)}:** **${l.title.slice(c + 1).trim()}**`, W, { size: 10.8, align: 'center' }), { fill: C.pink, keepNext: true, solid: true }));
      R.push(full(txt(l.ref, W, { size: 8.8, i: true, align: 'center' }), { fill: C.pink, keepNext: true, solid: true }));
      R.push(full(layoutBlocks(l.blocks, W - 10, { size: 10 })));
    });
    R.push(full(txt('**Key Assessment**', W, { size: 10.2 }), { fill: C.pink, keepNext: true, solid: true }));
    R.push(full(layoutBlocks(d.assessment, W - 10, { size: 10 })));
    R.push(full(txt('**Reflection & Remarks**', W, { size: 10.2 }), { fill: C.pink, keepNext: true, solid: true }));
    R.push(full(layoutBlocks(d.reflection, W - 10, { size: 10 })));
    return R;
  }

  function paginate(d, footer) {
    const top = PAGE.mt, bottom = PAGE.h - PAGE.mb, X0 = PAGE.ml;
    const pages = [];
    let ops = [], y = top;
    const newPage = () => { pages.push(ops); ops = []; y = top; };
    const cellH = c => c.slices.reduce((t, s) => t + s.h, 0) + 2 * c.padV;
    const drawCells = (cells, y0, h) => {
      for (const c of cells) {
        if (c.fill) ops.push({ t: 'rect', x: X0 + c.x, y: y0, w: c.w, h, fill: c.fill });
        let cy = y0 + c.padV;
        for (const s of c.slicesNow) { ops.push(...s.draw(X0 + c.x + c.padH, cy)); cy += s.h; }
      }
      for (const c of cells) ops.push({ t: 'rect', x: X0 + c.x, y: y0, w: c.w, h, stroke: C.border, lw: 0.7 });
    };
    const R = rows(d);
    for (let r = 0; r < R.length; r++) {
      let row = R[r];
      let cells = row.cells.map(c => ({ ...c, rest: c.slices.slice() }));
      let first = true;
      for (let guard = 0; guard < 60; guard++) {
        const need = Math.max(row.minH || 0, ...cells.map(c => c.rest.reduce((t, s) => t + s.h, 0) + 2 * c.padV));
        let avail = bottom - y;
        // keep header rows with the start of the next row
        if (row.keepNext && first) {
          let nextStart = 0, k = r + 1;
          while (k < R.length && R[k].keepNext) { nextStart += Math.max(R[k].minH || 0, ...R[k].cells.map(cellH)); k++; }
          if (k < R.length) nextStart += Math.min(48, Math.max(...R[k].cells.map(cellH)));
          if (need + nextStart > avail && y > top + 1) { newPage(); avail = bottom - y; }
        }
        if (need <= avail) { cells.forEach(c => { c.slicesNow = c.rest; }); drawCells(cells, y, need); y += need; break; }
        if ((row.solid || avail < 60) && y > top + 1) { newPage(); continue; }
        // split the row: each cell takes what fits, respecting keep-with-next and figure groups
        let took = false;
        cells.forEach(c => {
          let acc = 2 * c.padV, k = 0;
          while (k < c.rest.length && acc + c.rest[k].h <= avail) { acc += c.rest[k].h; k++; }
          // a tall table row can itself be split between pages
          if (k < c.rest.length && c.rest[k].split && avail - acc > 50 && !(k > 0 && c.rest[k - 1].keep && c.rest[k - 1] === c.rest[k].thead && false)) {
            const parts = c.rest[k].split(avail - acc);
            if (parts) {
              c.rest.splice(k, 1, ...parts); acc += parts[0].h; k++;
              while (k < c.rest.length && acc + c.rest[k].h <= avail) { acc += c.rest[k].h; k++; }
            }
          }
          while (k > 0 && k < c.rest.length && c.rest[k - 1].keep) k--;
          if (k > 1 && c.rest.length - k === 1 && c.rest[k].h < 40) k--;   // never carry a single short line over
          if (k === 0 && c.rest.length && y <= top + 1) k = 1;   // a slice taller than a page: place it anyway
          c.slicesNow = c.rest.slice(0, k); c.rest = c.rest.slice(k);
          if (c.rest.length && c.rest[0].thead && c.rest[0] !== c.rest[0].thead && c.slicesNow.length && c.slicesNow[c.slicesNow.length - 1] !== c.rest[0].thead) c.rest.unshift(c.rest[0].thead);
          if (k) took = true;
        });
        if (!took && y > top + 1) { cells.forEach(c => { c.rest = [...c.slicesNow, ...c.rest]; }); newPage(); continue; }
        drawCells(cells, y, bottom - y);
        newPage(); first = false;
        // label cells (short) are not repeated; their fill continues
        row = { ...row, keepNext: false };
      }
    }
    pages.push(ops);
    // footers
    const N = pages.length;
    pages.forEach((p, i) => {
      const fy = PAGE.h - PAGE.mb + 18;
      p.push(...textOps(footer, PAGE.ml, fy, 'R', 8, C.grey));
      const t = `Page ${i + 1} of ${N}`;
      p.push(...textOps(t, PAGE.w - PAGE.mr - textW(t, 'R', 8), fy, 'R', 8, C.grey));
      p.push({ t: 'line', x: PAGE.ml, y: fy - 10, x2: PAGE.w - PAGE.mr, y2: fy - 10, lw: 0.4, color: '#BBBBBB' });
    });
    return pages;
  }

  function layout(d) {
    const footer = `${d.subject} · Year ${d.year || 1} · Week ${d.week} · Learning Planner${d.className ? ' · ' + d.className : ''}`;
    return { pages: paginate(d, footer), size: [PAGE.w, PAGE.h] };
  }
  return { layout, PAGE, textWidth: textW, shape };
})();

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   A small PDF writer for the typeset pages: embedded TrueType subsets
   (Unicode, so ℕ ℤ ℚ ℝ, √, ≠, ₵ and Ghanaian letters print correctly),
   vector rules and maths, lossless images, selectable and searchable text.
   Also draws the same pages as SVG for the on-screen preview.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
const PDFOut = (() => {
  const enc = new TextEncoder();
  const b64bytes = b64 => { const s = atob(b64); const u = new Uint8Array(s.length); for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) u[i] = s.charCodeAt(i); return u; };
  const hex2 = n => n.toString(16).padStart(4, '0');
  const num = v => (Math.round(v * 100) / 100).toString();
  const rgb = h => { const x = parseInt(h.slice(1), 16); return [(x >> 16 & 255) / 255, (x >> 8 & 255) / 255, (x & 255) / 255].map(v => num(v)).join(' '); };
  const pdfStr = s => /^[\x20-\x7e]*$/.test(s) ? '(' + s.replace(/[\\()]/g, m => '\\' + m) + ')' : '<FEFF' + [...s].map(c => { const cp = c.codePointAt(0); if (cp < 0x10000) return hex2(cp); const v = cp - 0x10000; return hex2(0xD800 + (v >> 10)) + hex2(0xDC00 + (v & 1023)); }).join('') + '>';

  async function deflate(bytes) {
    if (typeof CompressionStream === 'undefined') return null;
    try {
      const cs = new CompressionStream('deflate');
      const out = new Response(new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(cs)).arrayBuffer();
      return new Uint8Array(await out);
    } catch (e) { return null; }
  }
  // read a non-interlaced 8-bit RGB or palette PNG: its IDAT stream is already a zlib stream with PNG predictors
  function pngImage(u) {
    const dv = new DataView(u.buffer, u.byteOffset, u.byteLength);
    let p = 8, w = 0, h = 0, bd = 8, ct = 2, il = 0, plte = null; const idat = [];
    while (p < u.length) {
      const n = dv.getUint32(p), type = String.fromCharCode(u[p + 4], u[p + 5], u[p + 6], u[p + 7]);
      const d = u.subarray(p + 8, p + 8 + n);
      if (type === 'IHDR') { w = dv.getUint32(p + 8); h = dv.getUint32(p + 12); bd = u[p + 16]; ct = u[p + 17]; il = u[p + 20]; }
      else if (type === 'PLTE') plte = d;
      else if (type === 'IDAT') idat.push(d);
      else if (type === 'IEND') break;
      p += 12 + n;
    }
    if (il || !(ct === 2 || ct === 3 || ct === 0)) throw new Error('Unsupported PNG for PDF (colour type ' + ct + ')');
    const total = idat.reduce((t, d) => t + d.length, 0); const data = new Uint8Array(total); let o = 0; for (const d of idat) { data.set(d, o); o += d.length; }
    let cs = '/DeviceRGB', colors = 3;
    if (ct === 3) { cs = `[/Indexed /DeviceRGB ${plte.length / 3 - 1} <${Array.from(plte, b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')}>]`; colors = 1; }
    if (ct === 0) { cs = '/DeviceGray'; colors = 1; }
    return { w, h, bpc: bd, cs, colors, data };
  }
  const bezCircle = (cx, cy, r) => {
    const k = 0.5523 * r;
    return `${num(cx + r)} ${num(cy)} m ${num(cx + r)} ${num(cy + k)} ${num(cx + k)} ${num(cy + r)} ${num(cx)} ${num(cy + r)} c ${num(cx - k)} ${num(cy + r)} ${num(cx - r)} ${num(cy + k)} ${num(cx - r)} ${num(cy)} c ${num(cx - r)} ${num(cy - k)} ${num(cx - k)} ${num(cy - r)} ${num(cx)} ${num(cy - r)} c ${num(cx + k)} ${num(cy - r)} ${num(cx + r)} ${num(cy - k)} ${num(cx + r)} ${num(cy)} c f`;
  };

  async function make(lay, meta) {
    const [PW, PH] = lay.size;
    const chunks = []; let pos = 0; const offs = [];
    const push = u => { chunks.push(u); pos += u.length; };
    const text = s => push(enc.encode(s));
    let nobj = 0; const objs = [];
    const alloc = () => ++nobj;
    const writeObj = (id, body) => { offs[id] = pos; text(`${id} 0 obj\n`); if (typeof body === 'string') text(body); else body(); text('\nendobj\n'); };
    const stream = async (id, dict, bytes, compress = true) => {
      let data = bytes, filter = '';
      if (compress) { const z = await deflate(bytes); if (z && z.length < bytes.length) { data = z; filter = '/Filter /FlateDecode '; } }
      writeObj(id, () => { text(`<< ${dict} ${filter}/Length ${data.length} >>\nstream\n`); push(data); text('\nendstream'); });
    };
    text('%PDF-1.7\n%âãÏÓ\n'.replace(/[\u0080-ÿ]/g, c => c));
    const catalog = alloc(), pagesId = alloc(), info = alloc();
    // which fonts and images are used
    const usedF = new Set(), usedI = new Set(), usedG = {};
    for (const p of lay.pages) for (const o of p) {
      if (o.t === 'text') { usedF.add(o.f); (usedG[o.f] = usedG[o.f] || new Set()); o.gids.forEach(g => usedG[o.f].add(g)); }
      if (o.t === 'img') usedI.add(o.id);
    }
    const fontRes = {}, fontIds = {};
    let fi = 0;
    for (const k of usedF) { fontIds[k] = { type0: alloc(), cid: alloc(), desc: alloc(), file: alloc(), tou: alloc(), name: 'F' + (++fi) }; }
    const imgIds = {}; let ii = 0;
    for (const id of usedI) imgIds[id] = { obj: alloc(), name: 'Im' + (++ii) };
    const pageIds = lay.pages.map(() => ({ page: alloc(), content: alloc() }));
    // fonts
    for (const k of usedF) {
      const F = FONTS[k], ids = fontIds[k];
      const tag = 'PLAN' + String.fromCharCode(65 + Object.keys(fontIds).indexOf(k)) + 'A+';
      const base = '/' + tag + F.name.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9-]/g, '');
      const maxG = Math.max(...Object.values(F.map).map(v => v[0]));
      const wArr = new Array(maxG + 1).fill(F.notdef);
      for (const v of Object.values(F.map)) wArr[v[0]] = v[1];
      writeObj(ids.type0, `<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type0 /BaseFont ${base} /Encoding /Identity-H /DescendantFonts [${ids.cid} 0 R] /ToUnicode ${ids.tou} 0 R >>`);
      writeObj(ids.cid, `<< /Type /Font /Subtype /CIDFontType2 /BaseFont ${base} /CIDSystemInfo << /Registry (Adobe) /Ordering (Identity) /Supplement 0 >> /FontDescriptor ${ids.desc} 0 R /CIDToGIDMap /Identity /DW ${F.notdef} /W [0 [${wArr.join(' ')}]] >>`);
      writeObj(ids.desc, `<< /Type /FontDescriptor /FontName ${base} /Flags ${F.flags} /FontBBox [${F.bbox.join(' ')}] /ItalicAngle ${F.italic} /Ascent ${F.asc} /Descent ${F.desc} /CapHeight ${F.cap} /StemV ${k.includes('B') ? 120 : 80} /FontFile2 ${ids.file} 0 R >>`);
      const ttf = b64bytes(F.b64);
      // FontFile2 needs /Length1 = uncompressed length
      const z = await deflate(ttf);
      writeObj(ids.file, () => { const data = z && z.length < ttf.length ? z : ttf; text(`<< /Length1 ${ttf.length} ${data === z ? '/Filter /FlateDecode ' : ''}/Length ${data.length} >>\nstream\n`); push(data); text('\nendstream'); });
      // ToUnicode for the glyphs used
      const back = {}; for (const [cp, v] of Object.entries(F.map)) if (usedG[k].has(v[0]) && !(v[0] in back)) back[v[0]] = +cp;
      const ents = Object.entries(back).map(([g, cp]) => `<${hex2(+g)}> <${cp < 0x10000 ? hex2(cp) : (v => hex2(0xD800 + (v >> 10)) + hex2(0xDC00 + (v & 1023)))(cp - 0x10000)}>`);
      let cm = '/CIDInit /ProcSet findresource begin\n12 dict begin\nbegincmap\n/CIDSystemInfo << /Registry (Adobe) /Ordering (UCS) /Supplement 0 >> def\n/CMapName /Adobe-Identity-UCS def\n/CMapType 2 def\n1 begincodespacerange\n<0000> <FFFF>\nendcodespacerange\n';
      for (let i = 0; i < ents.length; i += 100) { const part = ents.slice(i, i + 100); cm += `${part.length} beginbfchar\n${part.join('\n')}\nendbfchar\n`; }
      cm += 'endcmap\nCMapName currentdict /CMap defineresource pop\nend\nend';
      await stream(ids.tou, '', enc.encode(cm));
      fontRes[k] = ids.name;
    }
    // images: raw RGB compressed at build time, or the PNG's own compressed pixels (PNG predictors)
    for (const id of usedI) {
      const f = FIGS[id];
      if (f.raw) {
        const data = b64bytes(f.raw);
        writeObj(imgIds[id].obj, () => { text(`<< /Type /XObject /Subtype /Image /Width ${f.pw} /Height ${f.ph} /ColorSpace /DeviceRGB /BitsPerComponent 8 /Filter /FlateDecode /Length ${data.length} >>\nstream\n`); push(data); text('\nendstream'); });
        continue;
      }
      const im = pngImage(b64bytes(f.png));
      writeObj(imgIds[id].obj, () => { text(`<< /Type /XObject /Subtype /Image /Width ${im.w} /Height ${im.h} /ColorSpace ${im.cs} /BitsPerComponent ${im.bpc} /Filter /FlateDecode /DecodeParms << /Predictor 15 /Colors ${im.colors} /BitsPerComponent ${im.bpc} /Columns ${im.w} >> /Length ${im.data.length} >>\nstream\n`); push(im.data); text('\nendstream'); });
    }
    // pages
    const fontDict = '<< ' + Object.entries(fontIds).map(([k, v]) => `/${v.name} ${v.type0} 0 R`).join(' ') + ' >>';
    const xobj = Object.keys(imgIds).length ? '/XObject << ' + Object.values(imgIds).map(v => `/${v.name} ${v.obj} 0 R`).join(' ') + ' >>' : '';
    for (let i = 0; i < lay.pages.length; i++) {
      const ops = [];
      let curFill = null, curStroke = null, curLW = null;
      const fill = c => { if (c !== curFill) { ops.push(rgb(c) + ' rg'); curFill = c; } };
      const strokeC = c => { if (c !== curStroke) { ops.push(rgb(c) + ' RG'); curStroke = c; } };
      const lw = w => { if (w !== curLW) { ops.push(num(w) + ' w'); curLW = w; } };
      for (const o of lay.pages[i]) {
        const Y = v => num(PH - v);
        if (o.t === 'rect') {
          if (o.fill) { fill(o.fill); ops.push(`${num(o.x)} ${Y(o.y + o.h)} ${num(o.w)} ${num(o.h)} re f`); }
          if (o.stroke) { strokeC(o.stroke); lw(o.lw || 0.6); ops.push(`${num(o.x)} ${Y(o.y + o.h)} ${num(o.w)} ${num(o.h)} re S`); }
        } else if (o.t === 'line') {
          strokeC(o.color || '#111111'); lw(o.lw || 0.6);
          ops.push(`${num(o.x)} ${Y(o.y)} m ${num(o.x2)} ${Y(o.y2)} l S`);
        } else if (o.t === 'poly') {
          strokeC(o.color || '#111111'); lw(o.lw || 0.6);
          ops.push('1 J 1 j ' + o.pts.map(([x, y], k) => `${num(x)} ${Y(y)} ${k ? 'l' : 'm'}`).join(' ') + ' S 0 J 0 j');
        } else if (o.t === 'circle') {
          fill(o.color || '#111111'); ops.push(bezCircle(o.x, PH - o.y, o.r));
        } else if (o.t === 'text') {
          fill(o.color || '#111111');
          ops.push(`BT /${fontRes[o.f]} ${num(o.size)} Tf 1 0 0 1 ${num(o.x)} ${Y(o.y)} Tm <${o.gids.map(hex2).join('')}> Tj ET`);
        } else if (o.t === 'img') {
          ops.push(`q ${num(o.w)} 0 0 ${num(o.h)} ${num(o.x)} ${Y(o.y + o.h)} cm /${imgIds[o.id].name} Do Q`);
        }
      }
      await stream(pageIds[i].content, '', enc.encode(ops.join('\n')));
      writeObj(pageIds[i].page, `<< /Type /Page /Parent ${pagesId} 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 ${num(PW)} ${num(PH)}] /Resources << /Font ${fontDict} ${xobj} >> /Contents ${pageIds[i].content} 0 R >>`);
    }
    writeObj(pagesId, `<< /Type /Pages /Kids [${pageIds.map(p => p.page + ' 0 R').join(' ')}] /Count ${pageIds.length} >>`);
    writeObj(catalog, `<< /Type /Catalog /Pages ${pagesId} 0 R /ViewerPreferences << /DisplayDocTitle true >> >>`);
    const d = new Date(), pad = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
    const date = `D:${d.getFullYear()}${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}${pad(d.getDate())}${pad(d.getHours())}${pad(d.getMinutes())}${pad(d.getSeconds())}`;
    writeObj(info, `<< /Title ${pdfStr(meta.title || 'Learning Planner')} /Subject ${pdfStr(meta.subject || '')} /Creator (Core Maths Planner) /Producer (Core Maths Planner) /CreationDate (${date}) >>`);
    const xref = pos;
    let x = `xref\n0 ${nobj + 1}\n0000000000 65535 f \n`;
    for (let i = 1; i <= nobj; i++) x += String(offs[i]).padStart(10, '0') + ' 00000 n \n';
    text(x + `trailer\n<< /Size ${nobj + 1} /Root ${catalog} 0 R /Info ${info} 0 R >>\nstartxref\n${xref}\n%%EOF\n`);
    const out = new Uint8Array(pos); let o = 0;
    for (const c of chunks) { out.set(c, o); o += c.length; }
    return out;
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------- SVG pages for the preview */
  let fontsReady = null;
  function loadFonts() {
    if (fontsReady) return fontsReady;
    fontsReady = (async () => {
      if (typeof FontFace === 'undefined' || !document.fonts) return;
      await Promise.all(Object.keys(FONTS).map(async k => {
        try { const ff = new FontFace('PLN-' + k, b64bytes(FONTS[k].b64).buffer); await ff.load(); document.fonts.add(ff); } catch (e) { }
      }));
    })();
    return fontsReady;
  }
  const esc = s => s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
  function svgPage(ops, size) {
    const [W, H] = size;
    const parts = [`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" class="sheet-svg" role="img" aria-label="Planner page"><rect width="${W}" height="${H}" fill="#fff"/>`];
    for (const o of ops) {
      if (o.t === 'rect') {
        if (o.fill) parts.push(`<rect x="${num(o.x)}" y="${num(o.y)}" width="${num(o.w)}" height="${num(o.h)}" fill="${o.fill}"/>`);
        if (o.stroke) parts.push(`<rect x="${num(o.x)}" y="${num(o.y)}" width="${num(o.w)}" height="${num(o.h)}" fill="none" stroke="${o.stroke}" stroke-width="${o.lw || 0.6}"/>`);
      } else if (o.t === 'line') parts.push(`<line x1="${num(o.x)}" y1="${num(o.y)}" x2="${num(o.x2)}" y2="${num(o.y2)}" stroke="${o.color || '#111'}" stroke-width="${o.lw || 0.6}"/>`);
      else if (o.t === 'poly') parts.push(`<polyline points="${o.pts.map(([x, y]) => num(x) + ',' + num(y)).join(' ')}" fill="none" stroke="${o.color || '#111'}" stroke-width="${o.lw}" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>`);
      else if (o.t === 'circle') parts.push(`<circle cx="${num(o.x)}" cy="${num(o.y)}" r="${num(o.r)}" fill="${o.color || '#111'}"/>`);
      else if (o.t === 'text') parts.push(`<text x="${num(o.x)}" y="${num(o.y)}" font-family="PLN-${o.f}" font-size="${num(o.size)}" fill="${o.color || '#111'}" xml:space="preserve">${esc(o.str)}</text>`);
      else if (o.t === 'img') parts.push(`<image x="${num(o.x)}" y="${num(o.y)}" width="${num(o.w)}" height="${num(o.h)}" href="data:image/png;base64,${FIGS[o.id].png}"/>`);
    }
    parts.push('</svg>');
    return parts.join('');
  }
  return { make, svgPage, loadFonts };
})();

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   The page: four quick inputs, a note the planner understands, live A4 pages,
   and Word / PDF files that are prepared in the background so a tap saves them.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
(() => {
  const PROFILE_REG_KEY = 'core-maths-profiles-v1';
  let profileRegistry = (() => {try {const a=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PROFILE_REG_KEY)||'null'); if(a && Array.isArray(a.items)&&a.items.length && a.items.length<100)return a;}catch(e){} return {active:'default',items:[{id:'default',name:'My teaching profile'}]};})();
  let activeProfile = profileRegistry.items.some(x=>x.id===profileRegistry.active)?profileRegistry.active:'default';
  const KEY = 'core-maths-planner-v3';
  const profileKey = () => 'core-maths-planner-v4-' + activeProfile;
  const draftsKey = () => 'core-maths-weekdrafts-v1-' + activeProfile;
  const persistRegistry = () => {profileRegistry.active=activeProfile;try{localStorage.setItem(PROFILE_REG_KEY,JSON.stringify(profileRegistry));}catch(e){}};
  const jsonStore = (key,fallback) => {try{const x=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)||'null');return x&&typeof x==='object'?x:fallback;}catch(e){return fallback;}};
  let drafts = jsonStore(draftsKey(),{});
  const writeDrafts = () => {try{localStorage.setItem(draftsKey(),JSON.stringify(drafts));return true;}catch(e){return false;}};
  const currentDraft=()=> drafts[S.week] || (drafts[S.week]={overrides:{},notes:'',reflection:'',status:'planning'});
  const cloneJSON=x=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(x));
  let editPast=[],editFuture=[];
  function archiveCurrent(){
    if(!S||!S.week)return;
    const d=currentDraft();const keep={...S};delete keep.lastWeek;delete keep.week;delete keep.claudeRead;
    d.settings=keep;d.savedAt=new Date().toISOString();writeDrafts();
    const el=document.getElementById('wsSaveStatus');if(el)el.textContent='✓ This week is saved on this device · '+new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
  }
  // only what belongs to one week comes back with it (its dates, days, notes and Claude adaptations);
  // the teacher, school, class and preferences stay as they are now
  const WEEK_KEYS=['weekStart','day1','day2','notes1','notes2','ai'];
  function restoreWeek(id){
    const d=drafts[id];
    if(d&&d.settings){for(const k of WEEK_KEYS)if(k in d.settings)S[k]=d.settings[k];}
    else{S.notes1='';S.notes2='';S.ai=null;}
    S.week=id;
  }
  function updateProfilePicker(){
    const p=document.getElementById('wsProfile');if(!p)return;
    p.innerHTML=profileRegistry.items.map(x=>`<option value="${escH(x.id)}">${escH(x.name)}</option>`).join('');p.value=activeProfile;
  }

  const $ = (s, el = document) => el.querySelector(s);
  const $$ = (s, el = document) => Array.from(el.querySelectorAll(s));
  const EXTRA = { describe: '', claudeRead: null, lastWeek: {} };
  const YEARS = INDEX.years;
  const weekInfo = id => { for (const Y of YEARS) for (const w of Y.weeks) if (w.id === id) return { Y, w }; return null; };
  // Suggest a semester based on the built-in teaching week. This is a convenience,
  // not a substitute for the school's calendar; the teacher may change it.
  const semesterForWeek = id => { const inf = weekInfo(id); return inf && inf.w.w > Math.ceil(inf.Y.weeks.length / 2) ? '2' : '1'; };
  let S = load();
  let E = S, lockedKeys = new Set(), current = null, info = null, lay = null;

  function load() {
    for (const k of (activeProfile==='default' ? [profileKey(),KEY,'core-maths-planner-v2','core-maths-planner-v1']:[profileKey()])) {
      try {
        const v = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k) || 'null');
        if (v && typeof v === 'object') {
          const o = { ...DEFAULTS, ...EXTRA, ...v };
          if (typeof o.week === 'number' || /^\d+$/.test(String(o.week))) o.week = `y1w${String(+o.week || 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
          if (!weekInfo(o.week)) o.week = 'y1w01';
          // Older profiles can store Term 3. Migrate to a valid semester.
          if (!['1','2'].includes(String(o.term))) o.term = semesterForWeek(o.week);
          else o.term = String(o.term);
          return o;
        }
      } catch (e) { }
    }
    return { ...DEFAULTS, ...EXTRA };
  }
  const save = () => { try { localStorage.setItem(profileKey(), JSON.stringify(S)); } catch (e) { } };

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------ controls */
  const SEGS = {
    dur1: [[40, '40 min'], [60, '60'], [80, '80'], [120, '120']],
    dur2: [[40, '40 min'], [60, '60'], [80, '80'], [120, '120']],
    bandMode: [['manual', 'Percentages'], ['score', 'Last test average'], ['unknown', 'Not known']],
    seating: [['movable', 'Movable desks'], ['fixed', 'Fixed benches']]
  };
  $$('[data-seg]').forEach(el => { const k = el.dataset.seg; el.innerHTML = SEGS[k].map(([v, t]) => `<button type="button" role="radio" data-v="${v}" aria-checked="false">${t}</button>`).join(''); });
  const chips = (host, map, key) => { $(host).innerHTML = Object.entries(map).map(([k, label]) => `<label class="chip"><input type="checkbox" data-set="${key}" value="${k}"><span>${label}</span></label>`).join(''); };
  chips('#res', RESOURCES, 'res'); chips('#strat', STRATEGIES, 'strat'); chips('#fa', FORMATIVE, 'fa');
  $('#needs').innerHTML = Object.entries(NEEDS).map(([k, label]) => `<label class="need"><input type="checkbox" data-set="needs" value="${k}"><span>${label}</span><input class="cnt" type="number" min="0" max="60" inputmode="numeric" data-count="${k}" placeholder="How many?" aria-label="How many: ${label}"></label>`).join('');
  $('#programme').innerHTML = Object.entries(PROGRAMMES).map(([k, v]) => `<option value="${k}">${v}</option>`).join('');
  $$('.day').forEach(el => el.innerHTML = '<option value="">Not set</option>' + DAYS.map((d, i) => `<option value="${i}">${d}</option>`).join(''));
  /* ------------------------------------------------------------ year and week picker (68 weeks) */
  $('#years').innerHTML = YEARS.map(Y => `<button type="button" role="radio" data-year="${Y.y}" aria-checked="false">Year ${Y.y}</button>`).join('');
  let gridYear = 0;
  function drawGrid(y) {
    if (gridYear === y) return; gridYear = y;
    const Y = YEARS.find(x => x.y === y);
    $('#wgrid').innerHTML = Y.weeks.map(w => `<button type="button" class="wk" data-week="${w.id}" data-fam="${w.fam}" aria-pressed="false" title="Week ${w.w}: ${escH(w.title)}" aria-label="Week ${w.w}: ${escH(w.title)}">${w.w}</button>`).join('');
  }
  function pickerView() {
    const inf = weekInfo(E.week) || weekInfo('y1w01');
    drawGrid(inf.Y.y);
    $$('#years button').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-checked', String(+b.dataset.year === inf.Y.y)));
    $$('.wk').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b.dataset.week === inf.w.id)));
    $('#wTitle').textContent = `Week ${inf.w.w} · ${inf.w.title}`;
    $('#wSec').textContent = `Year ${inf.Y.y} · Section ${inf.w.sec}: ${inf.w.secName}`;
    const i = inf.Y.weeks.indexOf(inf.w);
    $('[data-wnav="-1"]').disabled = i === 0; $('[data-wnav="1"]').disabled = i === inf.Y.weeks.length - 1;
    $('#wsel').toggleAttribute('data-loading', !WEEKS[inf.w.id]);
    $('#className').placeholder = `e.g. ${inf.Y.y} Science A`;
    $('#headingIn').placeholder = ['', 'Learning Planner – Year One', 'Learning Planner – Year Two', 'Learning Planner – Year Three'][inf.Y.y];
    const review=$('#wsCurrReview');
    if(review){const flags=(WEEKS[inf.w.id]&&WEEKS[inf.w.id].meta&&WEEKS[inf.w.id].meta.flags)||[];
      review.hidden=!flags.length;review.textContent=flags.length?'⚠ '+flagText(flags):'';}
    const ln = $('#lmName'); if (ln) ln.textContent = `the Year ${inf.Y.y}, Week ${inf.w.w}`;
  }
  function setWeek(id) {
    const inf = weekInfo(id); if (!inf) return;
    // Preserve edits which may still be waiting for the normal input debounce.
    clearTimeout(timer);
    fromForm();
    archiveCurrent();
    restoreWeek(id);
    S.term = semesterForWeek(id);
    S.lastWeek = { ...(S.lastWeek || {}), [inf.Y.y]: id };
    render({ noRead: true });
  }
  // All 68 teaching weeks travel with this HTML. Parse only the selected pack.
  // A deployed legacy copy can still use the optional weeks/ folder as a fallback.
  const loading = {};
  function ensureWeek(id) {
    if (WEEKS[id]) return Promise.resolve(WEEKS[id]);
    if (loading[id]) return loading[id];
    loading[id] = Promise.resolve().then(async () => {
      const embedded = document.getElementById('pack-' + id);
      if (embedded) return JSON.parse(embedded.textContent);
      const response = await fetch(`weeks/${id}.json`);
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Week pack missing (HTTP ' + response.status + ')');
      return response.json();
    }).then(P => {
      if (P.id !== id) throw new Error('Week pack does not match the selected week');
      for (const [fid, f] of Object.entries(P.figImgs || {})) FIGS[`y${P.year}:${fid}`] = f;
      delete P.figImgs;
      const W = GEN.build(P);
      WEEKS[id] = W;
      NOTES[id] = W.meta.notesText;
      return W;
    }).catch(e => { delete loading[id]; throw e; });
    return loading[id];
  }
  function prefetch() {
    const inf = weekInfo(E.week); if (!inf) return;
    const i = inf.Y.weeks.indexOf(inf.w);
    for (const w of [inf.Y.weeks[i + 1], inf.Y.weeks[i - 1]]) if (w && !WEEKS[w.id]) ensureWeek(w.id).catch(() => { });
  }
  const TAPS = ['Some shy learners', 'Two learners with low vision', 'A learner who is deaf', 'A wheelchair user', 'Weak class', 'Strong class', 'No projector', 'We have a projector', 'No calculators', 'Fixed benches', 'Some latecomers', 'Many speak Twi'];
  $('#taps').innerHTML = TAPS.map(t => `<button type="button" class="tap">${t}</button>`).join('');
  const IDEAS = ['My class is weak in fractions', 'Make Lesson 1 more practical', 'Add a short game to each lesson', 'I will be observed by my head of department', 'Use more Ghanaian market examples', 'Help my HP learners go further'];
  $('#ideas').innerHTML = IDEAS.map(t => `<button type="button" class="tap">${escH(t)}</button>`).join('');

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------ the note the planner reads, as a live overlay */
  function effective() {
    const note = (S.describe || '').trim();
    if (!note) return { E: { ...S, term: ['1','2'].includes(String(S.term)) ? String(S.term) : semesterForWeek(S.week) }, set: {}, found: [], by: '' };
    let { set, found } = Smart.readClass(note, S);
    let by = 'Read on this device';
    if (S.claudeRead && S.claudeRead.text === note) { set = { ...set, ...S.claudeRead.set }; found = S.claudeRead.found || found; by = 'Read by Claude'; }
    const v = { ...S, ...set };
    v.term = ['1','2'].includes(String(v.term)) ? String(v.term) : semesterForWeek(v.week);
    return { E: v, set, found, by };
  }

  function toForm() {
    $$('[data-k]').forEach(el => {
      const k = el.dataset.k; const v = E[k];
      if (k === 'detailed') { el.checked = E.detail === 'detailed'; return; }
      if (el.type === 'checkbox') el.checked = !!v;
      else if (document.activeElement !== el) el.value = v ?? '';
    });
    $$('[data-seg]').forEach(el => { const v = String(E[el.dataset.seg]); $$('button', el).forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-checked', b.dataset.v === v ? 'true' : 'false')); });
    $$('[data-set]').forEach(el => { el.checked = (E[el.dataset.set] || []).includes(el.value); });
    $$('[data-count]').forEach(el => { if (document.activeElement !== el) { const c = (E.needCounts || {})[el.dataset.count]; el.value = c ? c : ''; } el.hidden = !(E.needs || []).includes(el.dataset.count); });
    $$('[data-show]').forEach(el => el.hidden = el.dataset.show !== E.bandMode);
    pickerView();
    // controls set by the note are shown but locked
    $$('.locked').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('locked'));
    const lockEl = el => el && el.classList.add('locked');
    for (const k of lockedKeys) {
      $$(`[data-lock="${k}"]`).forEach(lockEl);
      $$(`[data-k="${k}"]`).forEach(el => lockEl(el.closest('.field') || el.closest('.switch') || el.parentElement));
      $$(`[data-seg="${k}"]`).forEach(lockEl);
      if (k === 'needs' || k === 'needCounts') lockEl($('#needs'));
      if (k === 'res') lockEl($('#res'));
    }
    const note = (S.describe || '').toLowerCase();
    $$('#taps .tap').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('on', note.includes(b.textContent.toLowerCase())));
  }
  function fromForm(target) {
    $$('[data-k]').forEach(el => {
      const k = el.dataset.k;
      if (lockedKeys.has(k)) return;
      if (k === 'detailed') { S.detail = el.checked ? 'detailed' : 'standard'; return; }
      if (k === 'describe') { S.describe = el.value; return; }
      if (el.type === 'checkbox') S[k] = el.checked;
      else if (el.type === 'number') S[k] = el.value === '' ? '' : +el.value;
      else S[k] = el.value;
    });
    for (const key of ['needs', 'res', 'strat', 'fa']) if (!lockedKeys.has(key)) S[key] = $$(`[data-set="${key}"]`).filter(e => e.checked).map(e => e.value);
    if (!lockedKeys.has('needCounts') && !lockedKeys.has('needs')) {
      const counts = {};
      $$('[data-count]').forEach(el => { if ((S.needs || []).includes(el.dataset.count) && +el.value > 0) counts[el.dataset.count] = Math.round(+el.value); });
      S.needCounts = counts;
    }
  }


  function getAt(obj,path){return path.split('.').reduce((a,k)=>a==null?undefined:a[k],obj);}
  function setAt(obj,path,val){const bits=path.split('.');let o=obj;for(let i=0;i<bits.length-1;i++){o=o&&o[bits[i]];}if(o && bits[bits.length-1] in o)o[bits[bits.length-1]]=val;}
  function editableFields(d){
    const out=[];const add=(area,path,label,kind)=>{const v=getAt(d,path);if(typeof v==='string'||Array.isArray(v)&&v.every(x=>typeof x==='string'))out.push({area,path,label,kind:kind||(Array.isArray(v)?'lines':'text'),value:Array.isArray(v)?v.join('\n'):v});};
    add('Overview','heading','Document heading');add('Overview','subject','Subject');
    for(const [k,l] of [['strand','Strand'],['substrand','Sub-strand'],['standard','Content standard'],['outcome','Learning outcomes'],['indicators','Learning indicators'],['eqs','Essential questions']]){
      const bs=d[k]||[];bs.forEach((b,i)=>{if(typeof b.text==='string')add('Overview',`${k}.${i}.text`,`${l} ${i+1}`);if(Array.isArray(b.items)&&b.items.every(x=>typeof x==='string'))add('Overview',`${k}.${i}.items`,`${l} ${i+1}`,'lines');});
    }
    const sectionBlocks=(area,key)=>{(d[key]||[]).forEach((b,i)=>{if(typeof b.text==='string')add(area,`${key}.${i}.text`,`${area}: text ${i+1}`);if(Array.isArray(b.items)&&b.items.every(x=>typeof x==='string'))add(area,`${key}.${i}.items`,`${area}: list ${i+1}`,'lines');});};
    for(const [a,k] of [['Strategies','strategies'],['Resources','resources'],['Differentiation','diff'],['Assessment','assessment'],['Reflection','reflection']])sectionBlocks(a,k);
    (d.lessons||[]).forEach((l,i)=>{const area=`Lesson ${i+1}`;add(area,`lessons.${i}.title`,'Lesson title');(l.blocks||[]).forEach((b,j)=>{if(typeof b.text==='string')add(area,`lessons.${i}.blocks.${j}.text`,`Part ${j+1}: ${b.k==='h'?'heading':'text'}`);if(Array.isArray(b.items)&&b.items.every(x=>typeof x==='string'))add(area,`lessons.${i}.blocks.${j}.items`,`Part ${j+1}: list`,'lines');});});
    return out;
  }
  function extendLessons(doc){
    const n=Math.max(2,Math.min(6,+S.lessonCount||2));if(n<=2)return;
    const mins=Math.max(30,Math.min(120,+S.extraMin||40));
    const W=WEEKS[S.week];
    for(let i=2;i<n;i++){
      // Lessons 3–6 are practice / revision sessions made from this week's own quiz, exercise and theory questions
      if(W&&typeof W.practice==='function'){try{doc.lessons.push(W.practice(i-2,mins));continue;}catch(e){console.error(e);}}
      const o=(doc.indicators||[]).flatMap(b=>Array.isArray(b.items)?b.items:[]).filter(x=>typeof x==='string');
      const t1=Math.round(mins*.15),t2=Math.round(mins*.3),t4=Math.round(mins*.15),t3=mins-t1-t2-t4;
      const blocks=[
        B.h(`Introduction (${t1} min)`,{rule:true,before:2}),B.bar('Starter: recall',`${t1} min · whole class`),B.ul(['Ask learners to recall one important idea from the two core lessons and explain their reasoning before you reveal an answer.']),
        B.h(`Guided review (${t2} min)`,{rule:true,before:8}),B.bar('Re-teach the key ideas',`${t2} min · whole class`),B.ul(o.length?o:['Revisit the learning indicators for this week.']),
        B.h(`Independent practice (${t3} min)`,{rule:true,before:8}),B.bar('Practice',`${t3} min · individual, then pairs`),B.ul(['Use the Exercise and Theory questions of the Learner Material not yet done in class.']),
        B.h(`Closure (${t4} min)`,{rule:true,before:8}),B.bar('Exit ticket',`${t4} min · individual`),B.ul(['One related question without help; collect, identify errors and plan the next support.'])
      ];
      doc.lessons.push({title:`Lesson ${i+1} (${mins} min): ${(i-2)%2===0?'Guided practice and remediation':'Application and mastery'}`,ref:'Practice / revision session; it revisits this week\u2019s indicators and adds no new content.',blocks,timing:{intro:{mins:t1,items:[]},main:{mins:t2+t3,items:[]},close:{mins:t4,items:[]},dropped:[],carriedOut:[]}});
    }
    doc.duration=`2 core × ${doc.summary.lessons[0].D} min${doc.summary.lessons[1].D!==doc.summary.lessons[0].D?'/'+doc.summary.lessons[1].D:''}; ${n-2} practice × ${mins} min`;
  }
/* Assessment and differentiation restoration — Year 1 verified PLC schedule.
   The ordinary weekly assessment, mathematical examples and diagrams are kept in full.
   STP papers and scoring keys below are teacher-adapted examples, not official exam papers. */
const STP_ASSESSMENTS_YEAR1 = Object.freeze({
  1:{kind:'portfolio-start',name:'Individual portfolio — start',source:'PLC Handbook, Appendix A',
    intro:'Introduce the individual mathematics portfolio. Keep dated assignments, quizzes, projects, assessed scripts, corrections and reflections throughout the academic year. Recommended final review is around Week 23.',
    tasks:[String.raw`**Portfolio entry 1:** Classify $-7$, $0$, $\dfrac{3}{4}$ and $\sqrt{2}$ into the smallest appropriate number sets. Give a reason for each. (8 marks)`,
      'Keep the original work, the marked version and a short reflection describing an error you corrected (4 marks).'],
    answers:[String.raw`$-7\in\mathbb{Z}$; $0\in W$; $\dfrac{3}{4}\in\mathbb{Q}$; $\sqrt{2}$ is irrational. Award 1 mark for each correct classification and 1 for each valid reason (8 marks).`,

    rubric:['Correct classification and reasons: 8 marks (one classification and one explanation per number).','Evidence of correction and understanding: 4 marks (specific error 2; appropriate correction 2).','Use the first entry for feedback; the portfolio is assessed again on submission in Week 23.']},
  2:{kind:'group-start',name:'Group project — assign',source:'PLC Handbook, Appendix B: fractions, decimals and inverses',
    intro:'Set the group project now for submission in Week 9. The PLC sample project investigates fractions, decimal representations, and additive/multiplicative inverses through model charts. Give teams time to research later topics; do not require every calculation to be completed in Week 2.',
    tasks:[String.raw`**Investigation (20 marks):** Prepare a 2–3-page group report showing how $\dfrac{1}{2}$, $\dfrac{3}{4}$, $\dfrac{2}{5}$ and $\dfrac{5}{8}$ are written as decimals. Draw or construct a labelled model/chart for each fraction.`,
      String.raw`For $\dfrac{3}{4}$ and $-\dfrac{2}{5}$, state their additive inverses and multiplicative inverses. Show how a fraction and its multiplicative inverse give $1$ when multiplied.`,
      'Report sections: title, group members, objective, models and calculations, findings and conclusion. Submit a proposal by Week 3, chart draft around Week 6, and final report by Week 9.'],
    answers:[String.raw`$\dfrac{1}{2}=0.5$, $\dfrac{3}{4}=0.75$, $\dfrac{2}{5}=0.4$, $\dfrac{5}{8}=0.625$.`,
      String.raw`Additive inverses: $-\dfrac{3}{4}$ and $\dfrac{2}{5}$. Multiplicative inverses: $\dfrac{4}{3}$ and $-\dfrac{5}{2}$. Checks: $\dfrac{3}{4}\times\dfrac{4}{3}=1$ and $-\dfrac{2}{5}\times-\dfrac{5}{2}=1$.`,
      'A correct model must show the whole divided into equal parts and the shaded fraction clearly labelled.'],
    rubric:['Four correct fraction-to-decimal conversions: 4 marks (1 each).','Four accurately labelled visual models/charts: 4 marks (1 each).','Additive inverses: 2 marks (1 each); multiplicative inverses: 2 marks (1 each).','Two multiplication checks with correct working: 4 marks (2 each).','Clear explanation and logical report: 4 marks. Total: 20 marks.']},
  6:{kind:'exam',name:'First mid-semester assessment',source:'PLC Session 6 and Appendix E',
    intro:'A teacher-adapted 25-mark sample paper on work covered before the first mid-semester assessment (Weeks 1–5). Moderate the final paper with the Mathematics Department before recording STP scores.',
    tasks:[String.raw`**Q1 — Number sets (6 marks).** Classify $-8$, $\dfrac{5}{4}$ and $\sqrt{18}$ as integers, rational or irrational numbers; justify each answer.`,
      String.raw`**Q2 — Sets (6 marks).** Let $A=\{1,2,3,4,5\}$ and $B=\{2,4,6\}$. Find (a) $A\cap B$, (b) $A\cup B$, and (c) $A\setminus B$.`,
      String.raw`**Q3 — Fractions (8 marks).** Evaluate (a) $\dfrac{3}{4}+\dfrac{5}{6}$ and (b) $\dfrac{7}{8}\div\dfrac{14}{15}$. Simplify both answers.`,
      String.raw`**Q4 — Recurring decimals (5 marks).** Express $0.\overline{36}$ as a fraction in its lowest terms. Show each step.`],
    answers:[String.raw`**Q1 (6):** $-8\in\mathbb{Z}$ (1) because it is a negative whole integer (1); $\dfrac{5}{4}\in\mathbb{Q}$ (1) because it is a ratio of integers (1); $\sqrt{18}=3\sqrt{2}$ (1), irrational because $\sqrt{2}$ is irrational (1).`,
      String.raw`**Q2 (6):** $A\cap B=\{2,4\}$ (2); $A\cup B=\{1,2,3,4,5,6\}$ (2); $A\setminus B=\{1,3,5\}$ (2).`,
      String.raw`**Q3a (4):** $\dfrac{3}{4}+\dfrac{5}{6}=\dfrac{9}{12}+\dfrac{10}{12}=\dfrac{19}{12}=1\dfrac{7}{12}$. Common denominator (1), equivalent fractions (1), addition (1), correct simplified answer (1).`,
      String.raw`**Q3b (4):** $\dfrac{7}{8}\div\dfrac{14}{15}=\dfrac{7}{8}\times\dfrac{15}{14}=\dfrac{105}{112}=\dfrac{15}{16}$. Reciprocal (1), multiplication (1), simplification (1), final result (1).`,
      String.raw`**Q4 (5):** Let $x=0.363636\ldots$ (1). $100x=36.363636\ldots$ (1). Subtraction gives $99x=36$ (1). Thus $x=\dfrac{36}{99}=\dfrac{4}{11}$ (2 marks: fraction and simplification).`],
    rubric:['Mark the stated working steps, not just final answers. A valid alternative method earns full marks.','For each question: fully correct working gains all marks; partly correct method gains method marks; unsupported answers earn accuracy marks only when specified.','Performance bands for feedback (out of 25): 20–25 secure; 15–19 mostly secure; 10–14 developing; 0–9 requires targeted support.']},
  9:{kind:'group-due',name:'Group project — submission and scoring',source:'PLC Handbook, Appendix B',sameAs:2,
    intro:'Collect the fractions-and-decimals group project set in Week 2. Use the complete question sheet, worked answers and 20-mark analytic rubric below; give individual feedback on each member’s contribution.'},
  12:{kind:'exam',name:'First end-of-semester assessment',source:'PLC Session 12 and Appendix G',
    intro:'Teacher-adapted 25-mark cumulative sample paper on first-semester topics, including percentages, interest, algebraic expressions and linear equations. Use the departmental table of specifications for the actual examination.',
    tasks:[String.raw`**Q1 — Percentages (5 marks).** A laptop costs GH₵ $450$. It is discounted by $12\%$. Calculate the discount and sale price.`,
      String.raw`**Q2 — Simple interest (5 marks).** Find the simple interest and amount on GH₵ $1,200$ at $8\%$ per year for $3$ years.`,

  13:{kind:'individual-start',name:'Individual project — assign',source:'PLC Handbook, Appendix H: properties of straight lines',

    answers:[String.raw`**Line AB:** $m=\dfrac{10-2}{5-1}=2$; using $(1,2)$ gives $y-2=2(x-1)$, hence $y=2x$; $AB=\sqrt{(5-1)^2+(10-2)^2}=\sqrt{80}=4\sqrt{5}$ units.`,

Total: 20 marks.']},

      String.raw`**Q2 (5):** Interior sum $S=(5-2)\times180^\circ=540^\circ$ (formula 2; value 1). Each interior angle $\theta=\dfrac{540^\circ}{5}=108^\circ$ (2).`,

const SEN_TEXT={
  visual:'seat in a front group; large-print copies and a bold, high-contrast board; read every number and symbol aloud; describe each diagram.',
  hearing:'seat in a front group facing the teacher; write instructions, key words and answers on the board; face the class when speaking; agree hand signals; a note-taking buddy.',
  physical:'keep the aisles clear; bring the group task to the learner’s desk; a partner writes or moves cards on request; extra time for drawing.',
  reading:'a key-word wall with symbols and examples; read word problems aloud; short task cards; accept oral answers; extra time on exit tickets.',
  attention:'short tasks with visible time limits; an active role (materials, timekeeper); a step checklist to tick; seat away from the door.',
  language:'pre-teach the key words with symbols and examples; sentence frames; a bilingual buddy; explanations may start in a familiar Ghanaian language.',
  shy:'think–pair–share before whole-class answers; answers on boards or sticky notes first; the recorder role before the reporter role; praise effort and reasoning.',
  gifted:'the HP challenge task in every activity; the group-explainer role; the Theory questions and extension tasks.',
  absent:'a catch-up page (the Notes and the first worked example); a study buddy shares the exit-ticket answers; the Lesson 2 review recaps Lesson 1.',
  behaviour:'clear group roles and time limits; seat near the teacher; praise on-task behaviour; quick check-ins during group work.'
};
function clearDiffTablesAndKeepTasks(doc, settings) {
  const ctx=doc.summary.ctx, b=ctx.band, lessons=doc.summary.lessons;
  // two tasks for each readiness level, taken from the activities of the two lessons
  const taken={ap:[],p:[],hp:[]};
  for(const x of lessons){
    for(const item of x.timing.main.items){
      if(typeof item.tiers!=='function')continue;
      try{const t=item.tiers(ctx);for(const key of Object.keys(taken)){
        const v=(t[key]||[]).find(v=>typeof v==='string'&&v.trim());
        if(v&&taken[key].length<2&&!taken[key].some(z=>z.endsWith(v)))taken[key].push(`**Lesson ${x.i+1}, ${String(item.title).split(' – ')[0]}:** ${v}`);
      }}catch(e){}
    }
  }
  const lab=(t,o)=>B.label(t,{before:o===0?0:5});
  const rows=[];
  rows.push(lab('Class and grouping',0));
  const gender=ctx.single?`**Gender:** a single-sex class (${ctx.single}); roles rotate so every learner leads and reports once this week.`
    :ctx.paired?`**Gender:** ${ctx.paired.who} are a minority (${ctx.paired.who==='girls'?ctx.girls:ctx.boys} of ${ctx.n}), so they sit at least two to a group; nobody is the only ${ctx.paired.who==='girls'?'girl':'boy'} in a group, and they report first in alternate activities.`
    :ctx.girlShare<0.4?`**Gender:** girls are ${Math.round(ctx.girlShare*100)}% of the class; no group has only one girl, and girls report first in alternate activities.`
    :ctx.girlShare>0.6?`**Gender:** boys are ${Math.round((1-ctx.girlShare)*100)}% of the class; no group has only one boy.`
    :'**Gender:** a balanced class; girls and boys share the leader and reporter roles, and questions go to both in turn.';
  rows.push(B.ul([
    `**Class:** ${ctx.n} learners${ctx.single?` (all ${ctx.single})`:` (${ctx.boys} boys, ${ctx.girls} girls)`}, ${ctx.progName}.`,
    b.known?`**Readiness:** about ${b.ap} approaching proficiency (AP), ${b.p} proficient (P) and ${b.hp} highly proficient (HP)${b.source==='score'?`, estimated from the last test average of ${b.score}%`:''}; confirm with the Lesson 1 starter and exit ticket.`:'**Readiness:** not yet known; the Lesson 1 starter is a diagnostic, and readiness groups are formed from the first exit ticket.',
    `**Groups:** ${ctx.groups}${b.known&&b.hp?`, each with ${ctx.perGroup.hp} HP learner${ctx.perGroup.hp==='1'?'':'s'} as explainer`:''}${ctx.single?'':`; about ${ctx.perGroup.girls} girls and ${ctx.perGroup.boys} boys in each group`}.`,
    '**Roles:** leader, recorder, checker, timekeeper and reporter, rotated every lesson.',
    gender,
    ctx.movable?null:'**Seating:** fixed benches; pairs work with their bench partner and two benches turn to face each other for group tasks.',
    ctx.large?`**Large class (${ctx.n}):** number the groups and roles; leaders collect and return materials; use a hand signal for attention; mark exit tickets by sampling one group per lesson and peer marking.`:null
  ].filter(Boolean),{size:9.6}));
  rows.push(lab('Tasks and support by readiness'));
  const band=(key,name,n,support,fallback)=>{
    rows.push(B.ul([`**${name}${b.known?` – about ${n}`:''}:** ${support}`],{size:9.6}));
    rows.push(B.ol(taken[key].length?taken[key]:[fallback],{size:9.2,sub:true}));
  };
  band('ap','Approaching proficiency (AP)',b.ap,'prompt cards with the steps of the modelled examples; the first question done together; the teacher sits with this group at the start of practice; a peer buddy.','Model the first example, give guiding questions, then a similar problem with a partner.');
  band('p','Proficient (P)',b.p,'the worked examples in pairs, then the Exercise questions with answers checked in pairs.','Work through the core examples and explain the steps and answers.');
  band('hp','Highly proficient (HP)',b.hp,'explain to others; the Theory questions; make up and solve harder questions; extension tasks when time allows.','An extension problem: a proof, another method or a real-life application.');
  const needs=Object.keys(NEEDS).filter(k=>ctx.need(k));
  rows.push(lab('Inclusion (GESI)'));
  rows.push(B.ul([...needs.map(k=>`**${NEEDS[k]}${ctx.count(k)?` (${ctx.count(k)})`:''}:** ${SEN_TEXT[k]}${k==='language'&&ctx.lang?` (${ctx.lang})`:''}`),
    '**Learners who finish early:** move on to the next level of task (P to HP) instead of waiting.'],{size:9.6}));
  if(settings.primaryStrat)rows.push(B.ul([`**Chosen approach:** ${STRATEGIES[settings.primaryStrat]||settings.primaryStrat}; use the inquiry, discussion or practical activity already shown in the lesson sequence.`],{size:9.6}));
  if(settings.ai&&settings.ai.diff&&settings.ai.diff.length){rows.push(lab('Adaptations agreed with Claude'));rows.push(B.ul(settings.ai.diff.map(cleanText),{size:9.5}));}
  doc.diff=rows; return doc;
}
function appendVerifiedSTP(doc,settings){
  // Full original weekly formative assessment, model solutions and grading remain intact.
  clearDiffTablesAndKeepTasks(doc,settings);
  // The original teaching engine uses a generic 'Student Transcript Portal' heading for
  // its weekly key assessment. It is a potentially recordable class exercise, not a
  // scheduled STP milestone. Keep the tasks and marking rubric but label them accurately.
  for (const block of doc.assessment) {
    if(block.k==='h' && /key assessment for the student transcript portal/i.test(block.text||''))
      block.text='2. Weekly key assessment (worked questions and rubric)';
  }
  const firstKey=doc.assessment.findIndex(b=>b.k==='h'&&/2\. Weekly key assessment/.test(b.text||''));
  const rubric=[
    '**Fully secure:** Correct mathematical method, working and final response; award the full question marks stated in the mark scheme.',
    '**Developing:** Uses an appropriate method but makes an arithmetic, notation or explanation error; award earned method marks and explain the correction.',
    '**Needs support:** Missing key concepts or steps; provide one worked example, guided practice and a new question to check understanding.'
  ];
  doc.assessment.splice(firstKey>=0?firstKey:doc.assessment.length,0,
    B.h('Formative feedback rubric',{before:4,keep:true}),B.ul(rubric,{size:9.2}));
  if(Number(doc.year)!==1)return doc;
  const e=STP_ASSESSMENTS_YEAR1[Number(doc.week)]; if(!e)return doc;
  const exemplar=e.sameAs?STP_ASSESSMENTS_YEAR1[e.sameAs]:e;
  doc.assessment.push(B.h(`3. Scheduled STP component — ${e.name}`,{before:7,color:'accent',keep:true}));
  doc.assessment.push(B.p(`**Purpose and administration:** ${e.intro}`,{size:9.5}));
  doc.assessment.push(B.p('**Assessment questions / learner task**',{before:3,keep:true}));
  doc.assessment.push(B.ol(exemplar.tasks,{size:9.7}));
  if([6,12,18,24].includes(+doc.week)){
    const diagram={18:'stp-right-triangle',24:'stp-trapezium'}[Number(doc.week)];
    if(diagram)doc.assessment.push(B.fig(diagram,Number(doc.week)===18?'Diagram: right-angled triangle used for Question 3.':'Diagram: trapezium used for Question 2.',10.5));
  }
  if(+doc.week===13||+doc.week===21)doc.assessment.push(B.fig('stp-coordinate', 'Project guidance: labelled Cartesian axes and two straight lines; learners must construct their own accurately scaled graphs.',10.5));
  doc.assessment.push(B.h('Model answers and marking scheme',{before:5,keep:true}));
  doc.assessment.push(B.ol(exemplar.answers,{size:9.5}));
  doc.assessment.push(B.h('Rubric and feedback guidance',{before:4,keep:true}));
  doc.assessment.push(B.ul(exemplar.rubric,{size:9.4}));
  doc.assessment.push(B.note(`Assessment basis: ${e.source}. The questions and worked marking scheme are teacher-adapted samples aligned to the weekly Teacher Manual content; verify and moderate before use. STP timing follows the recommended Year 1 PLC schedule.`,{size:8.8}));
  return doc;
}

  function enhanceDoc(doc){
    extendLessons(doc);
    doc=appendVerifiedSTP(doc,S);
    const d=currentDraft();const overrides=d.overrides||{};
    for(const [path,entry] of Object.entries(overrides)){
      const old=getAt(doc,path);if(typeof old!=='string'&&!(Array.isArray(old)&&old.every(x=>typeof x==='string')))continue;
      const val=entry&&typeof entry.value==='string'?entry.value:typeof entry==='string'?entry:null;
      if(val===null)continue;setAt(doc,path,Array.isArray(old)?val.split(/\r?\n/).map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean):val);
    }
    const inf=weekInfo(S.week);
    if(S.carryForward!==false && inf){const ix=inf.Y.weeks.indexOf(inf.w);const pid=ix>0?inf.Y.weeks[ix-1].id:null;
      const previous=pid&&drafts[pid];if(previous&&(previous.reflection||'').trim())doc.diff.push(B.note('Follow-up from the previous teaching week (teacher reflection): '+plainTeacher(previous.reflection).slice(0,900)));}
    if((d.notes||'').trim())doc.reflection.push(B.note('Additional teacher notes: '+plainTeacher(d.notes)));
    if((d.reflection||'').trim())doc.reflection.push(B.note('Post-lesson reflection: '+plainTeacher(d.reflection)));
    if((d.status||'')==='taught')doc.extra.push('Teaching status: Taught');
    return doc;
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------ render */
  let timer = 0, fontsOK = false, buildTimer = 0, renderSeq = 0;
  const files = { key: '', docx: null, pdf: null, building: {} };
  const keyOf = () => JSON.stringify(E) + JSON.stringify(currentDraft()) + activeProfile;
  function render(opts = {}) {
    if (!opts.noRead) fromForm();
    const r = effective();
    E = r.E; lockedKeys = new Set(Object.keys(r.set));
    save();
    archiveCurrent();
    toForm();
    // what the note was understood as
    const u = $('#understood');
    if (r.found.length) { u.hidden = false; u.innerHTML = `<span class="lbl">✓ ${escH(r.by)}:</span>` + r.found.map(f => `<span class="tag">${escH(f)}</span>`).join(''); }
    else if ((S.describe || '').trim()) { u.hidden = false; u.innerHTML = '<span class="hint">Nothing to apply yet. Try numbers of learners, needs, resources or lesson lengths.</span>'; }
    else u.hidden = true;
    const seq = ++renderSeq;
    $('#busy').hidden = false;
    if (!WEEKS[E.week]) {
      const want = E.week;
      $('#pageCount').textContent = 'Loading selected week…';
      $('#pagesBox').innerHTML = '';
      ensureWeek(want).then(() => { if (seq === renderSeq) render({ noRead: true }); }).catch(err => {
        if (seq !== renderSeq) return;
        const inf = weekInfo(want);
        $('#busy').hidden = true;
        $('#pageCount').textContent = 'Unable to load selected week';
        $('#pagesBox').innerHTML = '<div class="card" role="alert">The selected week could not be opened. Please retry. Your selection has been kept.</div>';
        banner(`${inf ? `Year ${inf.Y.y}, Week ${inf.w.w}` : 'That week'} could not be loaded (${escH(err && err.message || 'unknown')}).`, 'err', '<button class="btn small primary" type="button" data-retry-week>Retry this week</button>');
      });
      return;
    }
    try {
      current = enhanceDoc(generate(E));
      pickerView();
      info = Smart.insights(current, E);
      lay = Typeset.layout(current);
      side(current); insightsView(info); tiles(current, info);
      const draw = () => {
        if (seq !== renderSeq) return;
        $('#pagesBox').innerHTML = lay.pages.map((p, i) => `<div class="sheet"><span class="pn">Page ${i + 1} of ${lay.pages.length}</span>${PDFOut.svgPage(p, lay.size)}</div>`).join('');
        $('#pageCount').textContent = `${lay.pages.length} pages · A4 landscape`;
        $('#busy').hidden = true;
      };
      if (fontsOK) draw(); else PDFOut.loadFonts().then(() => { fontsOK = true; draw(); }).catch(() => { fontsOK = true; draw(); });
      scheduleBuild();
      setTimeout(prefetch, 1200);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e); $('#busy').hidden = true;
      banner('The planner could not be built: ' + escH(e && e.message || String(e)) + '. Please tell Claude this message.', 'err');
    }
  }
  const schedule = () => { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(render, 160); };
  $('#form').addEventListener('input', e => { if (e.target.id === 'describe') { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(render, 450); } else schedule(); });
  $('#form').addEventListener('change', schedule);
  $('#form').addEventListener('click', e => {
    const seg = e.target.closest('[data-seg] button');
    if (seg) { const k = seg.parentElement.dataset.seg; if (lockedKeys.has(k)) return; S[k] = /^\d+$/.test(seg.dataset.v) ? +seg.dataset.v : seg.dataset.v; toFormSoft(); render(); return; }
    const st = e.target.closest('[data-step]');
    if (st) { const k = st.dataset.step; if (lockedKeys.has(k)) return; S[k] = Math.max(0, Math.min(200, (+S[k] || 0) + +st.dataset.d)); $(`[data-k="${k}"]`).value = S[k]; render(); return; }
    const wk = e.target.closest('.wk');
    if (wk) { if (lockedKeys.has('week')) { banner('The week is set by your note in step 4. Edit the note to change it.', 'warn'); return; } setWeek(wk.dataset.week); return; }
    const yb = e.target.closest('#years button');
    if (yb) {
      if (lockedKeys.has('week')) { banner('The year is set by your note in step 4. Edit the note to change it.', 'warn'); return; }
      const y = +yb.dataset.year, Y = YEARS.find(x => x.y === y);
      setWeek((S.lastWeek || {})[y] || Y.weeks[0].id); return;
    }
    const nv = e.target.closest('[data-wnav]');
    if (nv && !nv.disabled) {
      if (lockedKeys.has('week')) { banner('The week is set by your note in step 4. Edit the note to change it.', 'warn'); return; }
      const inf = weekInfo(E.week); const i = inf.Y.weeks.indexOf(inf.w) + +nv.dataset.wnav;
      if (inf.Y.weeks[i]) setWeek(inf.Y.weeks[i].id); return;
    }
    const tap = e.target.closest('#taps .tap');
    if (tap) {
      const t = tap.textContent, box = $('#describe');
      let v = box.value;
      if (v.toLowerCase().includes(t.toLowerCase())) v = v.replace(new RegExp('\\s*' + t.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&') + '\\.?', 'i'), '').trim();
      else v = (v.trim() ? v.trim().replace(/[.]?$/, '. ') : '') + t + '.';
      box.value = v; S.describe = v; render(); return;
    }
  });
  function toFormSoft() { $$('[data-seg]').forEach(el => { const v = String(S[el.dataset.seg]); $$('button', el).forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-checked', b.dataset.v === v ? 'true' : 'false')); }); }
  $('#moreBtn').addEventListener('click', () => { const a = $('#adv'); a.hidden = !a.hidden; $('#moreBtn').setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!a.hidden)); });

  function side(d) {
    const { ctx, lessons } = d.summary;
    const b = ctx.band;
    $('#total').textContent = `${ctx.n} learners`;
    $('#groupInfo').textContent = `· ${ctx.G} groups of ${ctx.size}`;

  function tiles(d, I) {

    const carried = lessons.some(x => x.timing.main.items.some(it => it.carried));
    t.push(['⏱', `${lessons.map(x => x.D).join(' + ')} minutes planned`, carried ? 'an unfinished activity is carried into Lesson 2' : `each lesson: ${lessons[0].timing.intro.mins} intro · ${lessons[0].timing.main.mins} main · ${lessons[0].timing.close.mins} closure`]);
    const figs = d.lessons.reduce((n, l) => n + l.blocks.filter(x => x && x.k === 'fig').length, 0);
    t.push(['◩', figs ? `${figs} diagram${figs > 1 ? 's' : ''} placed beside their text` : 'No diagrams', figs ? 'never split across pages' : 'turn them on in More settings']);
    const ka = d.assessment.filter(x => x.k === 'ol').flatMap(x => x.items).filter(i => /DoK/.test(i));

    t.unshift(['▤', `${M.label || 'Week'} · ${M.nEx || 0} worked examples`, `${d.lessons.length} lessons from the Learner Material${M.flags && M.flags.length ? ' (check the indicator wording)' : ''}`]);

      + adv.map(a => `<div class="tile tip"><span class="ic">💡</span><div><span>${escH(a.text)}</span><br><button type="button" class="btn small primary" data-apply="${I.advice.indexOf(a)}">${escH(a.label)}</button></div></div>`).join('');

    try { Promise.resolve(window.claude.use(name)).then(v => { if (!done) { done = true; clearTimeout(t); res(v || null); } }, () => { if (!done) { done = true; clearTimeout(t); res(null); } }); }

  /* save a file: through Claude when the page runs inside Claude, otherwise straight to the browser's Downloads */
  async function saveBytes(filename, data, mime) {
    if (hasClaude() && !host.ready) await waitHost(4000);

      try { await host.downloads.save({ filename, data: data instanceof Uint8Array ? new Uint8Array(data) : data.slice(0) }); return 'claude'; }
      catch (e) { if (e && e.code === 'declined') return 'declined'; console.warn('Claude download failed, using the browser instead', e); }

'danger' : 'primary'}" data-a="yes">${escH(ok)}</button></div></div>`;
      document.body.appendChild(box);

      const key = e => { if (e.key === 'Escape') done(input ? null : false); if (e.key === 'Enter' && document.activeElement !== box.querySelector('[data-a="no"]')) done(input ? inp.value : true); };

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------ Word / PDF: real browser downloads.
     Generation happens on demand, so editing does not freeze older phones. */
  function scheduleBuild() {
    clearTimeout(buildTimer);
    const k = keyOf();
    if (files.key !== k) {
      files.key = k;
      files.docx = null;
      files.pdf = null;
    }
    updateStates();
  }
  async function buildFile(fmt) {
    if (!current || !lay || !WEEKS[E.week]) throw new Error('The selected week is still loading.');
    const k = keyOf();
    if (files.key === k && files[fmt] && !files[fmt].error) return files[fmt];
    const active = files.building[fmt];
    if (active && active.key === k) return active.promise;
    const d = current, L = lay;
    const promise = (async () => {
      let data;
      if (fmt === 'docx') {
        const blob = await DOCX.make(d, TEMPLATE_B64);
        data = await blob.arrayBuffer();
      } else if (fmt === 'pdf') {
        data = await PDFOut.make(L, {
          title: `Learning Planner – ${d.subject} – Year ${d.year || 1}, Week ${d.week}${d.className ? ' – ' + d.className : ''}`,
          subject: 'GES Learning Planner'
        });
      } else throw new Error('Unsupported file format');
      if (!data || !data.byteLength) throw new Error('The generated document is empty');
      if (keyOf() === k) {
        files.key = k;
        files[fmt] = data;
      }
      return data;
    })();
    files.building[fmt] = { key: k, promise };
    try { return await promise; }
    finally {
      if (files.building[fmt] && files.building[fmt].promise === promise) delete files.building[fmt];
      updateStates();
    }
  }
  const size = x => x && x.byteLength ? (x.byteLength > 1048576 ? (x.byteLength / 1048576).toFixed(1) + ' MB' : Math.round(x.byteLength / 1024) + ' KB') : '';
  function updateStates() {
    for (const f of ['docx', 'pdf']) {
      const el = $(`[data-state="${f}"]`); if (!el) continue;
      const ready = files.key === keyOf() && files[f] && !files[f].error;
      const busy = !!files.building[f] && files.building[f].key === keyOf();
      el.textContent = ready ? `ready · ${size(files[f])}` : busy ? 'creating file…' : 'tap to save';
    }
  }
  const fileName = fmt => {
    const inf = weekInfo(E.week) || weekInfo('y1w01');
    const cls = (E.className || '').replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]+/g, ' ').trim();
    return `Learning Planner - Core Maths - Year ${inf.Y.y} Week ${inf.w.w}${cls ? ' - ' + cls : ''}.${fmt}`;
  };
  async function download(fmt) {
    if (!(await window.CMLP.guardExport())) return;
    const label = fmt === 'pdf' ? 'PDF' : 'Word';
    if (!WEEKS[E.week] || !current || !lay || $('#busy').hidden === false) {
      banner('The selected week is still being prepared. Please try again when the preview appears.', 'warn');
      return;
    }
    const filename = fileName(fmt);
    $$(`.dl[data-fmt="${fmt}"]`).forEach(b => b.disabled = true);
    try {
      banner(`Creating the ${label} document for ${escH(filename)}…`, '');
      const data = await buildFile(fmt);
      const mime = fmt === 'pdf' ? 'application/pdf' : 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document';
      if (host.downloads) banner(`Confirm the ${label} download in the dialog…`, '');

        banner(`<b>${label} file ready.</b> The browser should save it to your Downloads folder. If it does not start automatically, tap “Save file” below.`, 'ok', '<a class="btn small primary" id="saveFileAgain">Save file</a>');
        clearTimeout(bannerTimer); // keep the manual link visible on phones
        const link = $('#saveFileAgain'); link.href = r.url; link.download = filename;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Export failed:', e);

You can still copy the planner into Word.`, 'err', '<button class="btn small primary" type="button" data-copy>Copy for Word</button><button class="btn small ghost" type="button" data-retry="' + fmt + '">Retry export</button>');
    } finally {
      $$(`.dl[data-fmt="${fmt}"]`).forEach(b => b.disabled = false);
      updateStates();
    }
  }

  function wsUndoRedo(which){

  function wsAssessment(){
    if(!current)return;

    const q=A.reduce((n,b)=>n+(b.k==='ol'&&Array.isArray(b.items)?b.items.length:0),0);
    $('#wsAssessmentSummary').innerHTML=`<p><b>Year ${current.year}, Week ${current.week}</b> — ${escH(current.heading||current.subject)}.</p><p>${q} numbered assessment prompts found, plus other assessment and marking information where supplied. Both exports retain the original plan's assessment material.</p>`;
