  function assessmentDoc(){
    const d=current;const f=(a)=>Array.isArray(a)?a:[];
    return {...d,heading:'Assessment & Marking Guide — '+d.subject,duration:'Teacher assessment handout',
      strategies:[],resources:[B.p('Learners: exercise books and writing materials; calculators if permitted by the teacher.')],diff:[],
      lessons:[{title:`Year ${d.year} · Week ${d.week} — Assessment tasks`,ref:'Based on supplied weekly material. Verify accuracy before distribution.',blocks:[B.h('Assessment questions'),...f(d.assessment)]}],
      assessment:[],reflection:[B.note('Teacher copy: check the questions and any supplied marking information before giving learners the exercise.')],
      summary:d.summary};
  }
  async function wsExportAssessment(fmt){
    if(!current||!lay)return;
    const status=$('#wsAssessStatus'),btn=$('#wsAssess'+(fmt==='pdf'?'PDF':'Word'));btn.disabled=true;status.textContent='Generating assessment '+fmt.toUpperCase()+'…';
    try{
      const d=assessmentDoc();let data;if(fmt==='docx'){const blob=await DOCX.make(d,TEMPLATE_B64);data=await blob.arrayBuffer();}
      else data=await PDFOut.make(Typeset.layout(d),{title:'Core Maths Assessment Year '+d.year+' Week '+d.week,subject:'Assessment and marking guide'});
      if(!data||!data.byteLength)throw new Error('Empty assessment file');
      const name=`Core Maths Assessment - Year ${d.year} Week ${d.week}.${fmt}`;
      const r=await saveBytes(name,data,fmt==='pdf'?'application/pdf':'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document');
      status.textContent=r==='declined'?'Download cancelled.':'✓ Assessment document created. Review before distributing.';
    }catch(e){console.error(e);status.textContent='Export failed: '+(e&&e.message||e);}finally{btn.disabled=false;}
  }
  $('#wsAssessWord').addEventListener('click',()=>wsExportAssessment('docx'));
  $('#wsAssessPDF').addEventListener('click',()=>wsExportAssessment('pdf'));
  function wsSettings(){
    $('#wsSchool').value=S.school||'';$('#wsTeacher').value=S.teacher||'';
    $('#wsLessonCount').value=String(S.lessonCount||2);$('#wsExtraMin').value=String(S.extraMin||40);
    $('#wsTermStart').value=S.termStart||'';$('#wsBreakWeeks').value=S.breakWeeks||'';$('#wsCarryForward').checked=S.carryForward!==false;
  }
  function estimateMonday(start,w,exclusions){
    const m=/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(start||'');if(!m)return '';
    const dt=new Date(Date.UTC(+m[1],+m[2]-1,+m[3]));if(Number.isNaN(+dt))return '';
    dt.setUTCDate(dt.getUTCDate()-((dt.getUTCDay()+6)%7));
    const breaks=new Set((exclusions||'').split(/[\s,;]+/).filter(x=>/^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d$/.test(x)));
    let count=1;while(count<w){dt.setUTCDate(dt.getUTCDate()+7);const key=dt.toISOString().slice(0,10);if(!breaks.has(key))count++;}
    return dt.toISOString().slice(0,10);
  }
  $('#wsSaveSettings').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    S.school=$('#wsSchool').value.trim().slice(0,150);S.teacher=$('#wsTeacher').value.trim().slice(0,150);
    S.lessonCount=+$('#wsLessonCount').value;S.extraMin=+$('#wsExtraMin').value;
    S.termStart=$('#wsTermStart').value;S.breakWeeks=$('#wsBreakWeeks').value.slice(0,4000);S.carryForward=$('#wsCarryForward').checked;
    const inf=weekInfo(S.week);if(S.termStart&&inf)S.weekStart=estimateMonday(S.termStart,inf.w.w,S.breakWeeks);
    save();render({noRead:true});$('#wsSaveStatus').textContent='✓ Settings saved. Calendar dates are estimates; verify with your school.';wsSettings();
  });
  // Update date on week change, only when the teacher opted into an automatic calendar.
  const _baseSetWeek=setWeek;
  setWeek=function(id){_baseSetWeek(id);if(S.termStart){const inf=weekInfo(id);if(inf){S.weekStart=estimateMonday(S.termStart,inf.w.w,S.breakWeeks);render({noRead:true});}}};
  const backupKeys=()=>[PROFILE_REG_KEY,...profileRegistry.items.flatMap(p=>['core-maths-planner-v4-'+p.id,'core-maths-weekdrafts-v1-'+p.id])];
  $('#wsExportBackup').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    archiveCurrent();save();const data={schema:'core-maths-workspace-backup',version:1,created:new Date().toISOString(),store:{}};
    backupKeys().forEach(k=>{let v;try{v=localStorage.getItem(k);}catch(e){v=null;}if(k===PROFILE_REG_KEY&&!v)v=JSON.stringify(profileRegistry);if(v)data.store[k]=v;});
    saveBytes('Core-Maths-Teacher-Workspace-Backup-'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+'.json',new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(data,null,2)),'application/json').then(r=>{if(r!=='declined')banner('Full local workspace backup saved. Keep it in a safe place.','ok');});
  });
  $('#wsImportBackup').addEventListener('change',async e=>{
    const f=e.target.files&&e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;e.target.value='';
    if(f.size>8e6){banner('Backup is too large (8 MB limit).','err');return;}
    try{
      const data=JSON.parse(await f.text());if(data.schema!=='core-maths-workspace-backup'||data.version!==1||!data.store||typeof data.store!=='object')throw new Error('Not a compatible backup');
      const reg=JSON.parse(data.store[PROFILE_REG_KEY]||'null');if(!reg||!Array.isArray(reg.items)||!reg.items.length||reg.items.length>40)throw new Error('Profile list is invalid');
      for(const p of reg.items){if(!/^[-a-zA-Z0-9]{1,90}$/.test(p.id)||typeof p.name!=='string')throw new Error('Invalid profile');}
      const keys=[PROFILE_REG_KEY,...reg.items.flatMap(p=>['core-maths-planner-v4-'+p.id,'core-maths-weekdrafts-v1-'+p.id])];
      if(!(await uiAsk({text:'This will replace the local profiles and lesson edits on this browser with those in the backup. Continue?',ok:'Replace with backup',danger:true})))return;
      keys.forEach(k=>{if(typeof data.store[k]==='string')localStorage.setItem(k,data.store[k]);});
      profileRegistry=reg;activeProfile=reg.items.some(p=>p.id===reg.active)?reg.active:reg.items[0].id;persistRegistry();
      drafts=jsonStore(draftsKey(),{});S=load();E=effective().E;editPast=[];editFuture=[];updateProfilePicker();render({noRead:true});wsClose();
      banner('Backup restored. Your saved profiles and week-specific plans are available.','ok');
    }catch(e){banner('Import failed: '+escH(e&&e.message||String(e)),'err');}
  });
  // Expose only read-only diagnostics for QA.
  window.__workspaceTest={profiles:()=>profileRegistry.items.length,active:()=>activeProfile,draft:id=>drafts[id]||null,fields:()=>current?editableFields(current).length:0,assessment:()=>current?current.assessment.length:0,extras:()=>current?current.lessons.length:0};
  updateProfilePicker();
  persistRegistry();
  try{const probe='__maths_storage_test__';localStorage.setItem(probe,'ok');localStorage.removeItem(probe);}catch(e){$('#wsSaveStatus').textContent='⚠ This browser blocked device storage. Export documents before closing; automatic drafts may not persist. Open with Chrome or Edge from a normal browser tab.';}

  E = effective().E; lockedKeys = new Set(Object.keys(effective().set));
  toForm();

  /* Guided preparation: a deliberate, seven-step flow without changing the proven export engine. */
  const GSTEP=['Year','Week','Teacher','Class','Timetable','Preferences','Review'];
  let guidedStep=0, guidedYear=null,guidedWeek=null;
  const gw=$('#guidedWizard');
  function guidedSync(){
    E=effective().E;
    lockedKeys=new Set(Object.keys(effective().set));
    toForm();
    save();
    archiveCurrent();
  }
  function guidedField(key,value){
    if(key==='detailed')S.detail=value?'detailed':'standard';
    else if(['lessonCount','extraMin','boys','girls','dur1','dur2','lastScore','ap','p','hp','keyMins'].includes(key))S[key]=(value===''?'':Number(value));
    else if(['figs','homework'].includes(key))S[key]=!!value;
    else S[key]=value;
  }
  function guidedChoices(host,map,key){
    $(host).innerHTML=Object.entries(map).map(([k,label])=>`<label><input type="checkbox" data-gset="${key}" value="${escH(k)}"><span>${escH(label)}</span></label>`).join('');
  }
  guidedChoices('#guidedResources',RESOURCES,'res');
  guidedChoices('#guidedStrategies',STRATEGIES,'strat');
  guidedChoices('#guidedNeeds',NEEDS,'needs');
  guidedChoices('#guidedFormative',FORMATIVE,'fa');
  $('#guidedProgramme').innerHTML=Object.entries(PROGRAMMES).map(([k,v])=>`<option value="${escH(k)}">${escH(v)}</option>`).join('');
  $$('.guided-day').forEach(el=>el.innerHTML='<option value="">Not specified</option>'+DAYS.map((d,i)=>`<option value="${i}">${escH(d)}</option>`).join(''));
  $('#guidedStepper').innerHTML=GSTEP.map((name,i)=>`<button type="button" data-gtab="${i}" aria-label="Step ${i+1}: ${name}" disabled><span class="g-dot">${i+1}</span><span>${name}</span></button>`).join('');
  $('#guidedYears').innerHTML=YEARS.map(Y=>`<button type="button" class="guided-choice" data-gyear="${Y.y}" aria-pressed="false"><span class="big">${Y.y}</span><strong>SHS Year ${Y.y}</strong><small>${Y.weeks.length} weeks of Mathematics lessons</small></button>`).join('');
  function flagText(f){
    const parts=[];
    if(f.includes('indicators'))parts.push('the learning-indicator wording comes from the Learner Material outcomes (the Teacher Manual wording for this week was not available)');
    if(f.includes('header'))parts.push('the content standard and learning outcome were composed from the Learner Material');
    if(f.includes('indicators-scrambled'))parts.push('the Teacher Manual text for the indicators was damaged and needs checking');
    return (parts.length?'Please check against your Teacher Manual: '+parts.join('; '):'Source wording needs checking: '+f.join(', '))+'.';
  }
  // week number of the teaching year today, from the first Monday of teaching and the Mondays to skip (Settings)
  function teachingWeekNow(){
    const m=/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(S.termStart||'');if(!m)return null;
    const start=new Date(Date.UTC(+m[1],+m[2]-1,+m[3]));start.setUTCDate(start.getUTCDate()-((start.getUTCDay()+6)%7));
    const t=new Date();const today=new Date(Date.UTC(t.getFullYear(),t.getMonth(),t.getDate()));today.setUTCDate(today.getUTCDate()-((today.getUTCDay()+6)%7));
    if(today<start)return null;
    const breaks=new Set((S.breakWeeks||'').split(/[\s,;]+/).filter(x=>/^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d$/.test(x)));
    let w=1;const d=new Date(start);
    while(d<today&&w<40){d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate()+7);if(!breaks.has(d.toISOString().slice(0,10)))w++;}
    return breaks.has(today.toISOString().slice(0,10))?null:w;
  }
  function guidedCurriculumCheck(){
    const n=$('#guidedCurriculumFlag');const f=(guidedWeek&&WEEKS[guidedWeek]&&WEEKS[guidedWeek].meta&&WEEKS[guidedWeek].meta.flags)||[];
    n.hidden=!f.length;
    n.textContent=f.length?flagText(f):'';
  }
  function guidedWeekGrid(){
    if(!guidedYear)return;
    const Y=YEARS.find(x=>x.y===guidedYear);
    const now=teachingWeekNow(), nowW=now&&Y.weeks.find(w=>w.w===now);
    $('#guidedYearSub').textContent=`Year ${guidedYear} · ${Y.weeks.length} weeks available`+(nowW?` · by your teaching calendar this is Week ${now}: ${nowW.title}`:'');
    const search=$('#guidedWeekSearch').value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const filtered=Y.weeks.filter(w=>('week '+w.w+' '+w.title+' '+w.secName+' '+w.w).toLowerCase().includes(search));
    $('#guidedWeeks').innerHTML=filtered.map(w=>{const d=drafts[w.id]||{};const tag=w.w===now?' · this week':d.status==='taught'?' · ✓ taught':d.settings?' · saved':'';return `<button type="button" class="guided-week${w.w===now?' is-now':''}" data-gweek="${w.id}" aria-pressed="${w.id===guidedWeek}"><span class="g-weeknum">W${w.w}</span><span><strong>${escH(w.title)}</strong><small>${escH(w.secName||'Core Mathematics')}${tag}</small></span></button>`;}).join('');
    $('#guidedWeekEmpty').hidden=!!filtered.length;guidedCurriculumCheck();
  }
  function guidedPickWeek(id){
    const inf=weekInfo(id);if(!inf||inf.Y.y!==guidedYear)return;
    clearTimeout(timer);
    archiveCurrent();
    restoreWeek(id);
    S.term=semesterForWeek(id);
    S.lastWeek={...(S.lastWeek||{}),[guidedYear]:id};
    guidedWeek=id;
    guidedSync();
    guidedWeekGrid();
    ensureWeek(id).then(()=>{if(guidedWeek===id)guidedCurriculumCheck();}).catch(()=>{if(guidedWeek===id){const n=$('#guidedCurriculumFlag');n.hidden=false;n.textContent='This weekly lesson pack could not be loaded; please choose another week or retry later.';}});
  }
  function guidedFillFields(){
    $$('[data-gk]',gw).forEach(el=>{
      const key=el.dataset.gk;
      const v=key==='detailed'?S.detail==='detailed':S[key];
      if(el.type==='checkbox')el.checked=!!v;
      else el.value=v===undefined||v===null?'':String(v);
    });
    $$('[data-gset]',gw).forEach(el=>el.checked=(S[el.dataset.gset]||[]).includes(el.value));
    guidedShowConditional();
  }
  function guidedShowConditional(){
    $$('[data-gshow]',gw).forEach(el=>el.hidden=el.dataset.gshow!==S.bandMode);
    $('#guidedExtraWrap').hidden=(+S.lessonCount||2)<=2;
    const n=Math.max(0,(+S.boys||0)+(+S.girls||0));
    $('#guidedClassTotal').textContent=n?`${n} learners altogether · ${S.boys||0} boys and ${S.girls||0} girls. Group work will be tailored to this class.`:'Enter the numbers of boys and girls to customise group activities.';
  }
  function guidedSummaries(){
    const inf=guidedWeek?weekInfo(guidedWeek):null;
    const dur=(+S.dur1||60)+(+S.dur2||60)+Math.max(0,(+S.lessonCount||2)-2)*(+S.extraMin||40);
    const setCount=k=>(S[k]||[]).length;
    const txt=[
      ['Year & week',inf?`Year ${inf.Y.y} · Week ${inf.w.w}\n${inf.w.title}`:'Not selected',0],
      ['Teacher & school',`${S.teacher||'Not entered'}\n${S.school||'Not entered'} · ${S.className||'No class'}`,2],
      ['Class information',`${(+S.boys||0)+(+S.girls||0)} learners · ${S.boys||0} boys, ${S.girls||0} girls\nReadiness: ${S.bandMode==='score'?'Last assessment':S.bandMode==='manual'?'Ability groups':'Initial diagnostic'}`,3],
      ['Lesson schedule',`${S.lessonCount||2} sessions · ${dur} minutes\nSemester ${S.term||1}${S.weekStart?' · Week beginning '+S.weekStart:''}`,4],
      ['Teaching preferences',`${setCount('res')} resources · ${setCount('strat')} strategies · ${setCount('needs')} support needs\nAssessment: ${S.keyMode||'class exercise'} (${S.keyMins||20} min)`,5]
    ];
    $('#guidedReview').innerHTML=txt.map(([name,desc,idx])=>`<div class="guided-summary"><div class="guided-summary-head"><strong>${escH(name)}</strong><button type="button" data-gjump="${idx}">Change</button></div><p>${escH(desc)}</p></div>`).join('');
  }
  function guidedError(msg){$('#guidedError').textContent=msg||'';}
  function guidedValidate(){
    if(guidedStep===0&&!guidedYear)return 'Please choose Year 1, 2 or 3.';
    if(guidedStep===1&&!guidedWeek)return 'Please select the week you want to plan.';
    if(guidedStep===2){
      if(!(S.teacher||'').trim())return 'Enter the teacher’s name to continue.';
      if(!(S.school||'').trim())return 'Enter the school name to continue.';
      if(!(S.className||'').trim())return 'Enter the class name to continue.';
    }
    if(guidedStep===3){
      const a=+S.boys,b=+S.girls;
      if(!Number.isInteger(a)||!Number.isInteger(b)||a<0||b<0||a>200||b>200||a+b===0)return 'Enter a valid number of boys and girls (at least one learner in total).';
      if(S.bandMode==='score'&&(S.lastScore===''||+S.lastScore<0||+S.lastScore>100))return 'Enter a valid average between 0 and 100.';
      if(S.bandMode==='manual'&&[S.ap,S.p,S.hp].some(v=>v===''||+v<0||+v>100))return 'Enter the percentages for all three readiness groups.';
      if(S.bandMode==='manual'&&Math.abs((+S.ap||0)+(+S.p||0)+(+S.hp||0)-100)>.5)return 'The three readiness percentages must add up to 100%.';
    }
    return '';
  }
  function guidedShow(step){
    guidedStep=Math.min(6,Math.max(0,step));
    $$('[data-gstep]',gw).forEach(el=>el.hidden=+el.dataset.gstep!==guidedStep);
    $('#guidedProgressName').textContent=`STEP ${guidedStep+1} OF 7 · ${GSTEP[guidedStep].toUpperCase()}`;
    const progress=Math.round(100*(guidedStep+1)/7);
    $('#guidedProgressPct').textContent=`${progress}%`;
    $('#guidedFill').style.width=progress+'%';
    $$('#guidedStepper [data-gtab]').forEach(b=>{
      const i=+b.dataset.gtab;b.disabled=i>guidedStep;
      b.dataset.complete=i<guidedStep?'true':'false';
      b.setAttribute('aria-current',i===guidedStep?'step':'false');
      b.querySelector('.g-dot').textContent=i<guidedStep?'✓':i+1;
    });
    $$('#guidedYears [data-gyear]').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(+b.dataset.gyear===guidedYear)));
    if(guidedStep===1)guidedWeekGrid();
    if(guidedStep===6)guidedSummaries();
    guidedFillFields();guidedError('');
    $('#guidedBack').disabled=guidedStep===0;
    $('#guidedNext').textContent=guidedStep===6?'✦ Generate lesson plan':'Continue →';
    $('#guidedStepHint').textContent=guidedStep===6?'Review before exporting':`Step ${guidedStep+1} of 7`;
    const pos=gw.getBoundingClientRect().top+window.scrollY-15;
    window.scrollTo({top:Math.max(0,pos),behavior:'instant'});
  }
  $('#guidedWeekSearch').addEventListener('input',guidedWeekGrid);
  gw.addEventListener('click',e=>{
    const yr=e.target.closest('[data-gyear]');
    if(yr){const y=+yr.dataset.gyear;if(guidedYear!==y){guidedYear=y;guidedWeek=null;$('#guidedWeekSearch').value='';}$$('#guidedYears [data-gyear]').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(+b.dataset.gyear===guidedYear)));guidedError('');return;}
    const wk=e.target.closest('[data-gweek]');if(wk){guidedPickWeek(wk.dataset.gweek);guidedError('');return;}
    const tab=e.target.closest('[data-gtab]');if(tab&&!tab.disabled){guidedShow(+tab.dataset.gtab);return;}
    const jump=e.target.closest('[data-gjump]');if(jump){guidedShow(+jump.dataset.gjump);return;}
  });
  function guidedInput(e){
    const el=e.target;
    if(el.dataset.gk){
      const k=el.dataset.gk;
      guidedField(k,el.type==='checkbox'?el.checked:el.value);
      guidedShowConditional();
    }
    if(el.dataset.gset){
      const k=el.dataset.gset;
      S[k]=$$(`[data-gset="${k}"]`,gw).filter(x=>x.checked).map(x=>x.value);
    }
    save();
    guidedError('');
  }
  gw.addEventListener('input',guidedInput);
  gw.addEventListener('change',guidedInput);
  $('#guidedBack').addEventListener('click',()=>guidedShow(guidedStep-1));
  $('#guidedNext').addEventListener('click',async()=>{
    const problem=guidedValidate();if(problem){guidedError(problem);return;}
    if(guidedStep<6){guidedShow(guidedStep+1);return;}
    if (!(await window.CMLP.guardGeneration(weekInfo(guidedWeek)?.w?.w || 0))) return;
    // The first visible generation happens only after the final confirmation.
    guidedSync();
    document.body.classList.remove('guided-setup','guided-power');
    document.body.classList.add('guided-result');
    $('#guidedToggleAdvanced').setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');
    const inf=weekInfo(S.week);
    $('#guidedResultName').textContent=`Year ${inf.Y.y} · Week ${inf.w.w}: ${inf.w.title}`;
    $('#guidedResultSub').textContent=`${S.className} · ${S.teacher} · ${S.lessonCount||2} lessons. Preview below, then download Word or PDF.`;
    render({noRead:true});
    window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'});
  });
  function guidedReturn(step){
    document.body.classList.remove('guided-result','guided-power');document.body.classList.add('guided-setup');
    const inf=weekInfo(S.week);if(inf){guidedYear=inf.Y.y;guidedWeek=inf.w.id;}
    guidedShow(step);
  }
  $('#guidedEditAnswers').addEventListener('click',()=>guidedReturn(0));
  $('#guidedAnotherWeek').addEventListener('click',()=>{guidedReturn(1);guidedWeek=null;$('#guidedWeekSearch').value='';guidedWeekGrid();});
  $('#guidedToggleAdvanced').addEventListener('click',e=>{
    document.body.classList.toggle('guided-power');
    e.currentTarget.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(document.body.classList.contains('guided-power')));
    e.currentTarget.textContent=document.body.classList.contains('guided-power')?'Hide advanced options':'Advanced options';
  });
  // Make exports and preview unavailable until the final Generate action.
  document.body.classList.add('guided-setup');
  window.__guidedPlannerTest={step:()=>guidedStep,year:()=>guidedYear,week:()=>guidedWeek,mode:()=>document.body.classList.contains('guided-result')?'result':'setup',current:()=>current&&current.week};
  guidedShow(0);

})();
</script>
<script>/* Optional install support for HTTPS-hosted copies. Local HTML remains standalone. */
(function(){
  var hosted=location.protocol==='https:'||location.hostname==='localhost'||location.hostname==='127.0.0.1';
  var framed=false;try{framed=window.top!==window.self;}catch(e){framed=true;}
  if(!hosted||framed)return;   /* not inside an embedded viewer, where install is not possible */
  var link=document.createElement('link');link.rel='manifest';link.href='./manifest.webmanifest';document.head.appendChild(link);
  if('serviceWorker' in navigator)window.addEventListener('load',function(){navigator.serviceWorker.register('./sw.js').catch(function(){});});
})();
</script>
<script src="access.js"></script></body></html>
